title: Discogs Seller Defect Rate by Source
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=discogs:item
| stats avg(defect_flag) as defect_rate count as purchases by seller_name
| sort 0 - defect_rate
description: Ranks sellerss by seller defect rate.
value: Seller defect rate quickly shows which source is adding grading surprises or shipping problems.
implementation: Send seller defect rate events to `index=personal` and keep `seller_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of seller defect rate by sellers.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which sellerss stand out most for seller defect rate.
